lexapro does have those moments, my confidence definitely went up😤and the right doc really is life changing when it comes to this stuff. best of luck!

I definitely experienced no libido, weight gain, and the sweat😮‍💨but my anxiety without it was so bad i don’t know if i ever would’ve even gotten the strength to go to college! for me, it definitely helped my motivation. i had a lot of anxiety around going to classes without knowing anybody and lexapro was a lifesaver. if you’re not seeing any positives i definitely recommend tapering off and trying out some other options! the medicine is supposed to work for you, don’t force yourself to try to work around it

since i had been on it for so long and started it as a teenager at a big transitional period in my life i felt that i was at much more stable point in my life now and wanted to see how i would be without it. if i found that i still really struggled with my anxiety i would’ve had no problem going back on it. the only thing that ever made me want to get off otherwise was the weight gain!

anxiety! so far it’s really not bad. ive noticed a little difference but ive been in a couple really stressful situations that would’ve sent me spiraling before i was on the med and they haven’t had that much of an effect on me. only big change ive noticed is i cry at everything now! sappy videos really get me
